Factory A operations handbook.
Compressor-01 has a preventive maintenance interval of 14 days.
Compressor-01 has a maximum operating temperature limit of 82 C.
The emergency shutdown procedure for Compressor-01 is to isolate power, close valve A-17, and press the blue reset.
Alarm A-417 means low oil pressure.
The approved production target is 480 units/shift.
Operators must wear a face shield in the compressor cell.
